items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Father Spearsman, yeah, Stocker and Jackson.

ctx.x: No, well he mostly stuck to the music, you see. He couldn't memorize or nothing like that. You see, and everything that he wanted to play, he had to have the music for it, you see. He couldn't memorize it.
The Sonny South band, he played mostly Stocker and Jackson. Father Spearsman, yeah, Stocker and Jackson. He didn't have any range in the band.
No, you might know this guy, Caesar. At that time, he was very good with the range. Saxon. Saxon, yeah. And Sonny Johnson, yeah, Sonny Johnson. He was with the band, too. I never had met Sonny.
